h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Machilipatnam

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Machilipatnam

items.pText: Machilipatnam is an old port town on the Krishna district coast, known for its Kalamkari textiles and its exposure to the Bay of Bengal. Cyclones and strong coastal winds reach this stretch of Andhra Pradesh, usually between October and December. FunPlay Systems builds outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 940 km away, and delivers it to coastal Andhra by road.

Schools, colonies and public parks here need equipment that stays firmly in the ground in a storm and resists salt in the air the rest of the year. Tell us about your site, the ages of the children and how close you are to the sea. We will suggest equipment, mark the safe play area on a layout drawing and install through our team or a dealer once you approve.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Securing equipment on a cyclone-prone coast

c: On an exposed coastal site, choose grouted installation, with each post set in concrete, over a self-standing base. Tall, broad structures catch more wind, so a lower layout with separate
can make more sense than one high tower.

After any severe storm, walk the play area before children return. Check for loose bolts, debris caught in nets and damage from fallen branches, and call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 if anything is broken. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist the salt that settles between storms, and a fresh-water rinse now and then helps them last.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 940 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Is grouting necessary for playground equipment near the coast?
items.a: On exposed sites, yes. Setting each post in concrete holds the equipment firmly in strong winds. Self-standing bases suit sheltered courtyards where digging is not possible.

items.q: What should we check after a cyclone?
items.a: Look for loose fixings, debris in nets and damage from branches before children use the equipment again. Contact our after-sales team for any parts that need replacing.

items.q: Do you supply schools in Machilipatnam?
items.a: Yes. We supply schools, colonies and parks in coastal Andhra Pradesh, with equipment made in Vasai and installed by our team or a regional dealer.
